name: Shogun-sama wa Otoshigoro Fandisc -Gosanke Da yo! Zen'in Shuugou-
original_name: 将軍様はお年頃 ふぁんでぃすく -御三家だヨ！ 全員集合-
source: This is the fandisc for "Shogun-sama wa Otoshigoro" with after stories for each of the four heroines. There are also new routes for new character "Tokugawa Mitsukuni".
